## Notes by piece

### Nº 1
Ada said the nº 1 should be played "as if speaking", with the left hand under the right. *Mark it* in the score and **do not** rush the turn. Then she asked for it again, slower, and had us notice where the weight falls: on the first beat of each group, never on the last note before a breath. The recording we heard afterwards did the opposite, and that was the point of the comparison. ^p1
- [ ] practise nº 1 hands separately
- [x] listen to two recordings of nº 1
